principles: No blanket log transform; use each feature's registered scale_action.
Flag outliers without deleting samples or changing the frozen matrix.
Carry observation status; censored and model-imputed cells are not ordinary observations.
Fit data-dependent imputation, scaling, selection and dimension reduction inside training folds.
Manage the four derived sums separately until their formulas, scales and weights are verified.

derived_sum_policy.recompute: only after formulas, component scales and weights are verified
derived_sum_policy.aroma_hops_sum: NNLS fill preserves matrix completeness but does not verify its formula

status_codes.1: left_censored：低于检测限/共同底限，不是真缺失
status_codes.2: derived_imputed：派生变量原始缺失，经验证模型回填
